events.body:
## Context

`FAQ_CONTEXT` in `src/main.py` (about L68-70) tells the model `/api/mcp` has `search_bugs, submit_bug, get_leaderboard, scan_url` and `/api/scan` does SSL/TLS and file checks. `MCP_MANIFEST` offers only `chat`, `scan_url` and `get_onboarding_guide`, and `_run_scan` just asks the model for a checklist. Byte tells users about tools they can't use.

## What to do

1. Rewrite those lines to match the manifest and call the scan an "AI-generated checklist".
2. Add a test that every tool name in `FAQ_CONTEXT` is in `MCP_MANIFEST`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No nonexistent tools in `FAQ_CONTEXT`
- [ ] Drift test passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-byte
```
